summary: Tested all 23 requested items across new Valuation Studio features (FX rates, ratio history, translate-summary, screener, auth gating, x_factor cap, full Company.jsx UI including currency selector, theme toggle, thresholds modal, POC/POV anomalies + auto-correct, sensitivity matrix, hover tooltips on exchange-code / POC / POV / classic ratios, footer legal disclaimer, watchlist login prompt, Emergent Auth redirect). 12/13 new backend tests pass; 13/13 if you exclude the budget-capped LLM call for MU. All frontend flows work end-to-end.

minor.issue: Returns 502 'Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.0011348, Max budget: 0.001' — EMERGENT_LLM_KEY has a per-call budget cap that is too small for longer business summaries (MU summary is longer than AAPL). Short summaries like AAPL work fine. This is an LLM-key budget configuration issue, NOT a code bug. Backend correctly catches the error and returns 502 with detail.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Increase EMERGENT_LLM_KEY per-call budget (currently $0.001) or truncate the input prompt in /api/company/{ticker}/translate-summary before calling the LLM so MU-length summaries don't exceed the budget cap. Code itself is fine; only the LLM provider's $0.001 cap is too tight.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py is 1028 lines — recommended to split into smaller modules (routers/company.py, routers/calculate.py, routers/admin.py).
/app/frontend/src/pages/Company.jsx is 1490 lines — large single component; could be split into Hero, Inputs, Ratios, Sensitivity, History sub-components.

The POST /api/admin/run-screener endpoint is currently public per problem statement ('don't worry, will be locked behind admin auth later'). Confirmed unauthenticated callers can trigger the screener — must be locked down before production.

In compute_custom_ratios the breakdown key 'fcf_minus_netdebt_over_mcap_pct' returns the post-cap value but the field name implies the raw value. Consider renaming to 'x_factor_used_pct' to avoid ambiguity (breakdown also contains 'x_raw_pct' which is the pre-cap value, so functionally OK but naming is confusing).

AAPL test passed translate-summary because of cache hit (subsequent calls skip LLM). MU failed because cache was cold AND text was long enough to bust the 0.001 USD budget — consider truncating summary text to ~1500 chars before LLM call as a defensive measure.
test_credentials: Not applicable (auth flow can only be partially tested — confirmed redirect to https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=... works correctly).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full backend regression suite is in /app/backend/tests/test_valuation.py and /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py. Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. The only failing test (test_translate_summary_mu) is due to the LLM provider budget cap ($0.001 per call), NOT a code bug — main agent may want to truncate the input or increase the budget. Frontend verified at https://trend-mapper-2.preview.emergentagent.com with AAPL (POC=$123.32, POV=$163.12), SAP.DE (EUR→USD→JPY conversion works: €154.48→$179.65→¥28,563.68), SOUN (POC/POV anomaly auto-correct works: POV went from -2.94 to 7.49 matching POC). Theme toggle uses document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', ...) NOT a 'dark' class — test for that attribute when scripting. Tooltips use a custom HoverTip component (not native title), text appears on hover in a portal-like element.
rca of the issue: test_translate_summary_mu RCA: 1) Reproduced by GET /api/company/MU/translate-summary on a cold cache (first call after server restart). 2) Backend logs show 'litellm.BadRequestError: OpenAIException - Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.0011348, Max budget: 0.001'. 3) Same endpoint succeeds for AAPL because AAPL's translated summary is already cached from earlier tests (so no fresh LLM call). 4) Root cause: EMERGENT_LLM_KEY has a per-call max_budget of $0.001 USD which is exceeded when the business summary input is longer (MU has a longer summary than AAPL). 5) Mitigation options: (a) raise the budget cap on the LLM key, (b) truncate `business_summary` text to ~1500 characters before sending to the LLM in /app/backend/server.py translate_summary route, (c) compress the system prompt to reduce token cost. Backend gracefully returns 502 with detail — no crash.
